problem_statement: Let G have vertices {0,1,2,3,4,5} and edges {03,04,14,24,34,35}. Let M be the maximum-degree vertices. Define dist_max(M)=max{dist(u,v):u,v in M}, with value 0 for a singleton, and eccSet(M)=max{dist(v,M):v in V}. Let alpha(G) be the independence number and b(G) the maximum order of an induced bipartite subgraph. Compute M, alpha(G), b(G), dist_max(M), and eccSet(M). Decide the truth of alpha(G)+ceil(sqrt(eccSet(M))) <= b(G) and alpha(G)+ceil(sqrt(dist_max(M))) <= b(G).
